Container.Name: mularr
Container.Overview:
Mularr is a powerful integration for aMule that provides a functional web interface with a nostalgia-infused retro touch. It bridges the gap between classic P2P and modern automation tools by offering qBittorrent-compatible APIs and Torznab indexers, making it seamless to use aMule with apps like Sonarr and Radarr.
Key features: - *Arr integration: native support for Sonarr/Radarr via qBittorrent and Torznab API compatibility (API Path: /api/as-torznab-indexer, URL Base: /api/as-qbittorrent). - Bundled aMule daemon: no separate aMule container needed. - Telegram integration: download-complete notifications via bot, and optional use of the Telegram network as a download provider. - VPN ready: built-in Gluetun health checks and automatic forwarded-port updates (set GLUETUN_ENABLED=true and route this container through your Gluetun container). - Retro-style responsive web UI with multiple themes (Windows XP Classic, Windows 11 Experimental).
Notes: - The container runs as UID 1000 by default. On most Unraid systems this works out of the box; if you hit permission errors on your shares, add '--user 99:100' in Extra Parameters to run as nobody:users. - If no AUTH_USERNAME/AUTH_PASSWORD is set, the web UI and API are open without authentication. Set them if the port is reachable from untrusted networks. - For a HighID on the eD2k network, keep the eD2k TCP/UDP port mappings and forward them in your router (not needed when routing through Gluetun with port forwarding).
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: amule emule ed2k p2p sonarr radarr telegram qbittorrent torznab
Container.Requires: Optional: a Gluetun container if you want to route traffic through a VPN.
Container.Changes: Initial release for Unraid Community Applications.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the Mularr web interface and API.

Config.Name: eD2k TCP Port
Config.Description: aMule eD2k TCP port. Forward it in your router to get a HighID. Remove if routing through Gluetun.

Config.Name: eD2k UDP Port
Config.Description: aMule eD2k UDP port (Kad and extended protocol). Forward it in your router. Remove if routing through Gluetun.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent data: SQLite database and aMule configuration.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Download storage. Completed files go to /downloads, in-progress files to /downloads/.incomplete (see AMULE_INCOMING_DIR / AMULE_TEMP_DIR).

Config.Name: AUTH_USERNAME
Config.Description: Username for the web UI and the qBittorrent-compatible API. Leave both auth fields empty to disable authentication (not recommended).

Config.Name: AUTH_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the web UI and the qBittorrent-compatible API.

Config.Name: API_KEY
Config.Description: API key to authenticate requests from other apps without login (needed for the Torznab integration with Sonarr/Radarr). Can also be used as password with username 'apikey' for the qBittorrent API.

Config.Name: JWT_SECRET
Config.Description: Secret used to sign JSON Web Tokens. If not set, a random secret is generated on startup and existing sessions are invalidated after each restart.

Config.Name: AMULE_INCOMING_DIR
Config.Description: Directory (inside the container) where completed downloads are stored.

Config.Name: AMULE_TEMP_DIR
Config.Description: Directory (inside the container) for in-progress downloads.

Config.Name: AMULE_SHAREDDIR_RECURSIVE
Config.Description: Semicolon-separated absolute container paths to share recursively. When set, shared directories are managed at startup and become read-only in Settings.

Config.Name: AMULE_SHAREDDIR_EXPLICIT
Config.Description: Semicolon-separated absolute container paths to share (non-recursive).

Config.Name: AMULE_RESTART_INTERVAL_HOURS
Config.Description: How often (in hours) the monitoring service automatically restarts the aMule daemon. Set to 0 to disable.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
Config.Description: Telegram bot token for notifications about system events and transfer completions.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
Config.Description: Telegram chat ID for notifications.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_TOPIC_ID
Config.Description: Telegram topic ID for notifications (optional, for forum-style groups).

Config.Name: GLUETUN_ENABLED
Config.Description: Set to true when routing this container through a Gluetun container so the VPN forwarded port is automatically applied to aMule.

Config.Name: GLUETUN_API
Config.Description: Gluetun control server API URL.

Config.Name: GLUETUN_PORT_INDEX
Config.Description: When Gluetun forwards multiple ports, index of the 'ports' array to use instead of the default 'port' value. Leave empty for default behavior.
